LESSON: ASANAS (PHYSICAL POSTURES)

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: General
Strand: Yoga (Holistic wellness)
Topic 6.1: Asanas (Physical postures)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Asanas (Physical postures), part of Yoga (Holistic wellness) in Grade 6 General.

Key inquiry question: Why are Asanas important in Yoga? 2. What is the importance of Pranayam in life?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. brainstorm about the different types of Pranayams and Asanas,

2. collect pictures from magazines, newspapers/digital platforms on Pranayams and Asanas,

3. visit and participate in the celebration of International Yoga Day,

4. practise the Asanas with peers under the supervision of a resource person,

5. practice the breathing exercises of Pranaayam using digital device,

6. perform Pranayams correctly under the supervision of a resource person,

7. make a journal to record their Yoga practice and changes observed in themselves,

8. create a Yoga guidance video using digital devices,

9. demonstrate correct postures of Asanas. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. brainstorm about the different types of Pranayams and Asanas,
2. collect pictures from magazines, newspapers/digital platforms on Pranayams and Asanas,
3. visit and participate in the celebration of International Yoga Day,
4. practise the Asanas with peers under the supervision of a resource person,
5. practice the breathing exercises of Pranaayam using digital device,
6. perform Pranayams correctly under the supervision of a resource person,
7. make a journal to record their Yoga practice and changes observed in themselves,
8. create a Yoga guidance video using digital devices,
9. demonstrate correct postures of Asanas. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Asanas (Physical postures) together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Creativity: Learners enhance creativity when making a journal to record their Yoga practice and changes observed in

themselves.

• Citizenship: Learner develops national and cultural identity when visiting and participating in the celebration of International

Yoga Day.

Values:
Responsibility: Learner acquires excellence when performing Pranayams correctly under the supervision of a resource person.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Life skills: Learner enhances self-management skills when performing Pranayams correctly under the supervision of a resource

person.

Links to other Learning Areas:
Learner can relate the skills of using digital devices to make a journal to record their Yoga practice and changes observed in

themselves and create a Yoga guidance video and demonstrate correct postures of Asanas to the skills of using digital devices

learnt in Creative Arts.
